<title level="1" right="Cantrip 1" pfs="Limited">
[Bramble Bush](/Spells.aspx?ID=2444)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Wardens of Wildwood</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #203 Shepherd of Decay](/Sources.aspx?ID=243) pg. 78

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Area** 5-foot cube

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Saving Throw** 
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex

</row>

</column>

---

In a sudden burst of growth, you cause a thorned bush to sprout from the ground, lash around, and wither. Any creature in the area takes 1d4 piercing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2247)  Reflex saving throw. 

Until the start of your next turn, the area is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2368). Any creature entering the square takes 1d4 piercing damage with a basic Reflex saving throw.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 1d4, and the damage dealt by hazardous terrain increases by 1.
